Although Northwind's Policy (POL-3.1, P-2.3) requires response within 1 business day for critical queries, SIDE-1 paragraph 2 expressly excludes service levels from the Policy's override of the Agreement. Response times are service level provisions under MSA-2024 Clause 6, so the Agreement's 2 Business Days requirement governs.
